subject: 🏃 Thursday — 6 mi Progression + C30 Fuel Rehearsal (Wk 2)
html:
Tomorrow: 6 mi progression run — Week 2 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation & Durability. 72 days to race day. Double duty: progression stimulus + first run-load test of Neversecond C30, our locked-in fuel system for the whole training block and race day.

The run: 4 mi @ 9:00 easy, then 2 mi at threshold pace 7:15–7:25. Standard 5-min activation before you head out: quadruped hip CARs, banded lateral walks, glute bridges, plus the PT-prescribed quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side).

The hill rule (final 0.5 mi home is uphill): Switch from pace to HR for the climb. Lock the first 1.5 mi of the threshold block to 7:15–7:25 on the flat, then on the uphill half mile target 155–162 BPM on the Polar H10 (threshold band). Hard cap 165. Let pace drift to whatever it lands at — chasing 7:15 up a hill turns threshold into VO2 and defeats the workout.

C30 fuel rehearsal — the dry run for B2B:

WhenWhatCarbPurpose
5:30 AM (30 min pre-run)Small banana + 8 oz water with ½ scoop Neversecond C30 drink mix~30 gTop off liver glycogen, get fluid + electrolytes on board, taste-test the drink mix.
~Mile 3.5 (just before threshold)1 Neversecond C30 gel30 gStress the gut at threshold pace — closest analog to Sunday's MP finish.
Post-run (within 30 min)30+ g protein (4 eggs or 1.5 cup Greek yogurt + berries)—Standard repair window.

What to pay attention to: gel swallow at threshold pace (does it go down cleanly while breathing hard?), stomach feel for 10–15 min post-gel, any flavor fatigue from the drink mix. If C30 sits clean → locked from here to July 26 and we don't need to re-test brands. If anything's off — sweetness, sloshing, GI bite — flag it tomorrow and we adjust for Sunday.

B2B preview (Sunday): Same C30 protocol, scaled up — banana + ½ scoop drink mix 60 min pre-start, ½ scoop sip 15 min before gun, C30 gel at mile 3, C30 gel at mile 6 right before the MP transition. That's ~45 g/hr across the race, top of the Weeks 1–4 gut-training band.

Focus cue: Keep cadence sticky in the threshold block. You held 167 spm clean on Tuesday's 800s. If pace and HR are both honest, cadence will be too. On the uphill 0.5 mi, shorten the stride and let cadence carry you up; do not lengthen and grind.

Knee veto: 2/5 in the morning → drop the threshold portion, run the full 6 easy at 9:00, still do the C30 rehearsal (the fueling test is independent of the pace stimulus).

Prep tonight: Lay out C30 gel + drink mix scoop + bottle on the counter. Set 5:15 alarm. Bed by 10. PT follow-up Friday — bring her the week's data.
